mail.fallback: If the button does not work, open this link in your browser:
mail.footer: This email was sent automatically. Replies to it are not received.
mail.verification.title: Confirm your email address
mail.verification.intro: please take a moment to confirm your email address. That way a reset link reaches you too, should you ever forget your password.
mail.verification.outro: The link is valid for 24 hours. If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.
mail.change.title: Confirm your new email address
mail.change.intro: your account is to use this email address from now on. Please confirm it; only then does the change take effect.
mail.change.outro: The link is valid for 24 hours. Until then your current address stays active. If you did not request this, you can ignore this email.
mail.reset.title: Reset your password
mail.reset.intro: a new password was requested for your account. You can set it with the following link.
mail.reset.outro: The link is valid for one hour. If you did not request this, you can ignore this email; your password stays unchanged.
